text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm not hitting the track on my own
today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You ready, Helios?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I was born readyyy! ♪ Brrrat brrrat
brrrrrat! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Takarazuka Kinen, let's gooo! ★ Let's
slay this,
Palmster!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. And McQueen's here. Ryan too.
Even
Grandmother Mejiro's coming to
watch, just like
at the spring Tenno Sho.
But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm different today! Now I have something to be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What? She's not coming? Seriously?
choice_data_list: ...Sounds like Grandmother won't be able to make it.
...Sounds like Grandmother won't be able to make it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In place of encouragement, I give her
some
important information. Apparently,
Grandmother
Mejiro has an important
meeting back in
Hokkaido and can't
come today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
She's not coming... In other words...
I can
go wild!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: This is my chance to really let go!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aw yeahhh!

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheyyy! ☆ Let's gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmeeeer! Wooo!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Heliosss! Pew pew! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer heads to the paddock in
much
higher spirits than at the spring
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This Takarazuka Kinen is a carnival! And
me and
my bestie are gonna slaaay
todaaay!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waheeey! ☆ Turn! ♪ Shout! ♪ Rile up
that crowd!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We're the greatest duo you've ever seen!
No one
can keep up with these feet! ☆
'Cause we'll never
stop movin'! Yeet
yeet! ★

text_block_list.name: Palmer and Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheeeeeyyy! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Holy dumbbells! Get a load of Palmer,
McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I... don't know exactly what is going on,
but it
appears she is ready to fight back
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. She is quite out of control...
However, I will
admit that I like her
better this way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I'm here today... as myself.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Whether I win or lose... I can run as
myself. Let's
gooo!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Is that... Helios?! I think that's Helios!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Besides Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro
Ryan, there
are some other interesting
opponents here today.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey, boss! I didn't expect to see you at
the
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh, Bamboo?! No way!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Actually, now that I think about it, I do
remember
seeing your name on the
guest list...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory. She's the hot-blooded

disciplinary committee chair at Tracen
and is
known for being good at sprints
and miles.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What're you doing here? Isn't this
distance a little
much for you? Aren't
you gonna run outta steam
halfway?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know, but my fans have really
been going
wild for me. They're calling
me their dream.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So if they want me here, I've got no
choice but to
run, you know? The
Takarazuka Kinen's the race
where
dreams come true, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No kidding... Gotcha. Well, if you're
their dream,
then my dream is...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My bestie over there! We're runnin' all
the way to
the finish line, laughing like
what what!
